main_body: Tall two-door wardrobe, with a top slab, an edge highlight, an eave shadow, recessed doors and a base plinth
top_band: Mid orange-brown (L≈127) rows 1-4 with small grain patches, closed by a lighter edge-highlight row 5 (L=157)
evidence: The centre column x=8 reads as a top band (rows 1-4), then a distinct lighter front-edge line (row 5, L=157). Below that is a mid row band (6-7), then a dark eave shadow (rows 8-9, L=60), then the front face with doors (rows 10-27) and a base (28-30). The doors have dark inner edges and inner panels, so they read as inset. The top is only about as light as the front face, apart from the highlight line, so it is a modest top surface. It still matches the guide's green cabinet structure (top, edge line, eave), so it is not a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours, against 38-40 in the references. Its median is 9 colours per tile, against 17-20. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, and the outline and base line are pure black #000000, which gives the sticker look. The browns have only about 4 steps. Door panels and flanks are simple uniform fills, with no per-plank grain or speckle like the references. Next to the cheese stall and the well it looks thinner and flatter.
